settings.text: Everything you need to know about Aspire Bathrooms

settings.title: How much does shipping cost?
settings.text: We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $1,000 AUD. Orders under $1,000 AUD attract a flat-rate shipping fee. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.

settings.title: How long does delivery take?
settings.text: Most orders are dispatched within 1–3 business days. Delivery timeframes vary by location but typically range from 3–7 business days for metro areas and 5–10 business days for regional locations. Tracking information will be provided once your order is dispatched.

settings.title: Do you ship Australia-wide?
settings.text: Yes, we ship to all states and territories across Australia. Additional charges and extended delivery times may apply for remote locations.

settings.title: Do you have a product brochure?
settings.text: Yes! You can download our full product catalogue as a PDF from our Downloads page. It includes all products, specifications, and available finishes.

settings.title: What finishes are available?
settings.text: Our products are available in a range of finishes to suit any style. The most popular finishes are Matte Black, Chrome, and Stainless Steel. Individual product pages show all available finish options for that item.

settings.title: Are your products suitable for Australian conditions?
settings.text: Yes. All Aspire Bathrooms products are selected for their quality, durability, and suitability for Australian homes and conditions. Our fittings comply with relevant Australian standards.

settings.title: Do products come with a warranty?
settings.text: Warranty terms vary by product and brand. Warranty information is listed on individual product pages. For specific warranty inquiries, please contact us.

settings.title: How do I place an order?
settings.text: Simply browse our product range, add items to your cart, and proceed through checkout. We accept all major credit cards and PayPal. For large or trade orders, please contact us directly.

settings.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.text: Please contact us as soon as possible if you need to change or cancel your order. Once an order has been dispatched we may not be able to make changes. We'll do our best to assist you.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.text: We want you to be completely happy with your purchase. If you're not satisfied, please contact us within 30 days of receiving your order to discuss a return or exchange. Items must be in original, unused condition and packaging.

settings.title: Where can I see Aspire products in person?
settings.text: Aspire products are stocked at a range of bathroom showrooms and retailers across Australia. Visit our Stockists page to find your nearest location.

settings.title: I'm a trade customer — do you offer trade pricing?
settings.text: Yes, we work with plumbers, builders, and interior designers. Please contact us for information about our trade programme and pricing.
Our team is happy to help. Send us a message via the contact form and we'll get back to you within 1 business day.
